B-12 Packing With Mushroom Bars
I had decided after hearing another story from someone close about B pack (taking vitamins every day leading up to the trip). I was taking two B-12s per day for a week before my trip, and then 4 more the day of, thought nothing of it. So my girlfriend and I eat the chocolate, I ate 6 pieces equivalent to 3.5g and she had 3, equivalent to 1.75g.
It started off as a normal trip, we were having a good time, then, without getting into too much detail, my girl starts having a bad trip and I start to walk her through it. While I'm walking her through the bad trip, I start to feel really nauseous and I get up to go to the bathroom. I got maybe 3-4 steps off the couch when I start to lose feeling in my entire body and my vision started going dark.
I start to lose feeling in my entire body and my vision started going dark.
For those of you who haven't fainted before, it's not fun. I don't remember falling or even actually blacking out for that matter.
We were able to handle the situation okay thankfully, my blood pressure was in the dirt so we made some hot chocolate to bring it back up again.
